title: MichiHome
description: Michi Home root entity representing a trusted local home ecosystem.

version.description: Schema version of the Michi Home contract (always 1).

home_id.description: Unique, non-secret public identifier of the home (43 chars base64url).

home_name.description: Human-readable friendly name of the home.

home_root_public_key.description: Ed25519 public key of the Home Root Authority in base64url (43 chars, no padding).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the home was initialized.
